name: BTC long spot / short perpetual funding carry
author: Authors of the cited carry-trade study
instruments: BTC spot and BTC perpetual futures

indicators.hedge ratio: equal BTC notional long spot and short perpetual

entry_long: Buy 1 BTC spot and short equal-notional BTC perpetual when expected funding is positive
entry_short: Short leg only as hedge; no standalone directional entry
exit: Maintain matched notional; exit when carry turns unattractive or hedge constraint binds (exit threshold not specified)
filters: Check funding sign, margin and venue counterparty
claimed_performance: Paper highlights positive carry historically; funding and basis are variable and hedge imperfect.
implementation_notes: Source describes trade construction, not entry/exit thresholds. Liquidation on short leg and basis risk remain.
